scope: Semantic review of the /images navigation and community-stream declutter pass.
reviewed: Confirmed that /images passes showFilters=false to the shared public masonry stream, so the style preset row and aspect-ratio filter row are not rendered on the create surface.
Confirmed that Explore and public Star profile surfaces retain the shared filter contract and URL-driven style/aspect-ratio state.
Confirmed that the secondary Guidance action is removed from the Image Studio header and its unused styles are removed without affecting the remaining action controls.
Confirmed that the /images stream still exposes its primary sort, search, refresh and density controls, preserving discoverability while reducing competing choices.
Confirmed that the desktop header, mobile drawer/tab and footer Images destinations now open /images/library, while explicit Create/community-stream links remain on /images.

Confirmed that /explore uses the same quiet stream toolbar, with sort, search, refresh and density retained while style and aspect-ratio filter rows are omitted; existing query-driven filter inputs remain compatible for deep links.

validation.default_library_entry: Primary Images navigation targets /images/library and the studio initializes directly to its saved-work view.
validation.explore_declutter: Explore renders the shared stream with showFilters=false and updates metadata copy to describe search/discovery without promising visible style or ratio controls.
validation.documentation: npm run test:docs passed; docs:sync completed
validation.production_build: npm run build passed and generated 166 static pages
validation.lint: npm run lint passed with zero errors and eight pre-existing warnings

limits: The shared filter implementation remains available to Explore and public profile pages; this review does not claim those surfaces were intentionally simplified.
